notes: Alley names printed 'DAMSEY' (with 'ALLEY' printed in the block east of John) and 'GRAHAM' (10 ft label); suffix Alley added. John Street between Augusta and Front is built over by the Cincinnati Terminal Warehouses (correction slip, built 1924), so John/Augusta and John/Front are recorded as T on the John centerline. East of Central, Augusta continues as Commerce Street (about 12 ft, name from sheet 4 and key map), offset about 25 px south; recorded as two T's. Phoebe Alley (name from sheet 4, unlabelled here) opens off the east side of Central about 70 px south of Damsey and runs off the right edge toward Plum. Smith/Water drawn with a gap west of Smith, but sheet 2 shows that side built over by the C&O coal-terminal office, so kind=T. Smith, John and Central all run off the bottom edge (60 ft labels; 'No exposure to Ohio River'). C&O carriageway and tracks cross Front and Water diagonally east of Smith (ignored).
